blocks.text: Network topology computer network ka layout (naqsha) hai. Yeh batati hai ke devices aur cables kaise tarteeb diye gaye hain. Topology physical ya logical ho sakti hai. Physical topology asal connections (taarein aur jor) dikhati hai. Logical topology dikhati hai ke network mein data kaise behta hai. Topology network ki performance (karkardagi) aur maintenance (dekh-bhaal) par asar dalti hai.

Bus topology mein tamam devices ek hi main cable se jure hote hain. Data isi cable ke saath chal kar har device tak pohanchta hai. Yeh saada aur sasti hai. Main cable kharab ho jaye to poora network ruk sakta hai (jaise Figure 1.8 mein). Yeh chhote networks ke liye munasib hai. Bare networks ke liye bus topology achhi nahi.

blocks.alt: Bus topology: chhe devices (do desktop computers, laptop, do servers aur printer) har aik chhoti cable se aik lambi main cable se jura hai; main cable ke dono siron par terminator hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.8: Bus topology (kitab ki Figure 1.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 1.8 mein main cable beech se tooti hui chhapi hai, aur chhe mein se do devices sirf devices ke darmiyan ek patli taar par latke dikhaye gaye hain. Bus topology mein har device ek hi lagataar main cable se jura hota hai, is liye oopar ek poori main cable banayi gayi hai. Dono siron par terminator hai jo signal ko cable ke sire se wapas takrane se rokta hai.

Star topology mein tamam devices ek darmiyani (central) hub ya switch se jurte hain (jaise Figure 1.9 mein). Data isi darmiyani device se guzarta hai. Ise sambhalna aur barhana aasan hai. Ek device kharab ho to baqi par asar nahi parta. Darmiyani hub kharab ho jaye to network ruk jata hai. Aaj ke networks mein star topology bohat istemal hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Star topology: desktop computer, mobile phone, laptop aur printer har aik teer wali tooti lakeer se aik darmiyani hub ya switch se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.9: Star topology (kitab ki Figure 1.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ring topology mein devices ek gol raaste (circle) mein jure hote hain (jaise Figure 1.10 mein). Data ring mein ek hi simt (direction) mein chalta hai. Har device data leta hai aur aage bhej deta hai. Ek device kharab ho to poore network par asar par sakta hai. Yeh bus topology se zyada pecheeda (complex) hai. Aaj kal ring topology bohat kam istemal hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Ring topology: aik gol cable par rakhe devices: do tower computers, do desktop computers, laptop, printer aur oopar Wi-Fi nishan wala globe.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.10: Ring topology (kitab ki Figure 1.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Talaba ek daire mein khare hon aur ek paighaam aage barhayein. Baat karein ke agar ek talib-e-ilm ruk jaye to kya hota hai.

Mesh topology mein har device bohat se doosre devices se jura hota hai. Data bhejne ke kai raaste hote hain. Is se reliability (bharosa) aur fault tolerance (kharabi ke bawajood chalte rehna) barhti hai. Ek link toot jaye to baat-cheet nahi rukti. Mesh topology mehngi aur pecheeda hai. Yeh bare aur ahem (critical) networks mein istemal hoti hai.

Figure 1.11 mesh topology wala network dikhati hai. Is topology mein har device bohat se doosre devices se jura hai. Data apni manzil tak kai raaston se ja sakta hai. Agar ek connection toot jaye to data doosra raasta le leta hai. Yeh figure samjhati hai ke mesh topology bohat qabil-e-bharosa magar pecheeda kyun hai.

blocks.alt: Mesh topology: paanch devices (Wi-Fi nishan wala globe, do desktop computers, laptop aur printer), har aik alag lakeer se baqi har device se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.11: Mesh topology (kitab ki Figure 1.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Tree topology mein devices darakht (tree) ki tarah darja-ba-darja (hierarchical) tarteeb mein hote hain (jaise Figure 1.12 mein). Is mein bus aur star dono ki khoobiyan hain: kai star networks ek darmiyani backbone (bari main cable) se jure hote hain. Data root (main node, jar) se branches (shaakhon) aur sub-branches tak behta hai. Is se bare networks ko barhana aur sambhalna aasan hai. Lekin backbone kharab ho jaye to poore network par asar par sakta hai. Tree topology bare idaron mein aam istemal hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Tree topology: khari Backbone Cable jis ke dono siron par dhakkan hain. Concentrator (hub) S1 nodes A, B aur C ko jorta hai; S2 nodes D, E aur F ko; S2 se juri teesri concentrator (hub) nodes G, H aur I ko. Server seedha backbone se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.12: Tree topology (kitab ki Figure 1.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tree topology mein concentrators (hubs) S1, S2 aur teesra hub chhote star networks banate hain: har hub ke nodes (A se I) usi se jure hain. Yeh hubs aur server ek lambi backbone cable se jure hain, is liye backbone kharab ho to poora network ruk jata hai.
Network topologies ke fawaid aur nuqsanat

Har topology ke apne fawaid hain. Kuch lagane mein aasan aur sasti hain (jaise Table 1.1 mein). Kuch zyada bharosa aur achhi performance deti hain. Kuch ko barhana aasan hai. Kuch ko sambhalna mushkil aur mehnga hai. Sahi topology ka intikhab network ki zaroorat par munhasir hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Kuch topologies saada aur sasti hain. Kuch qabil-e-bharosa magar mehngi hain. Kuch barhane mein aasan hain. Kuch sambhalne mein mushkil hain. Intikhab zaroorat par munhasir hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si topology darmiyani hub ya switch use karti hai, aur kaun si sab se zyada qabil-e-aitbaar hai? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Star darmiyani hub ya switch use karti hai. Mesh sab se zyada qabil-e-aitbaar hai, kyunke har device ke kai raste hain, is liye data kharab link ke gird se ja sakta hai.

items: Topology: devices aur cables ka layout; physical (asal jor) ya logical (data ka bahao).
Bus: ek main cable. Star: darmiyani hub ya switch. Ring: daira, data ek simt mein.
Mesh: kai raaste, sab se qabil-e-bharosa magar mehngi. Tree: backbone par kai star networks.
Intikhab qeemat, bharose, barhane aur sambhalne ki aasani par.
